reasoning: Bottom-up tree DP records whether the parent holds B, the current device(none/A/B), and whether any child holds B. An edge u-v is guarded by A/B at either endpoint or B adjacent to either endpoint. The child-B flag therefore covers every incident edge of u, while only B at u affects the next level. Combine children with an OR state enforcing that flag, and test every edge using these exact local conditions.
